content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A YAML parser processes text into a representation and then constructs language-specific values. Parser libraries differ in API, supported version/schema, and safety defaults, so use safe loading, explicit versions, and real-target tests.

content_blocks.title: Inspectable example: YAML in Python
content_blocks.code:
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

data = yaml.safe_load(Path("config.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print(data["app"]["name"])
content_blocks.expected_output: With PyYAML installed and a config.yaml containing an app mapping, safe_load constructs basic safe values and the sample prints the configured name.
